name: Sticky Nav
description: Sticky top navbar whose desktop links drop down in a fish-eye wave on hover, with neighbors following. On mobile it collapses to a plus button that slides open a dropdown list.
contents: Logo text link on the left
Row of nav links with arrow icons
Mobile plus toggle and sliding dropdown list
behavior: Sticks to the top of the page while scrolling
Hovered link drops down and the next two links follow with decreasing offset, arrow rotates in
Below 768px links move into a dropdown that slides in from the top, toggled by a plus button
Links flagged extra only show on screens 1280px and wider on desktop
editableByProps: Logo text and link, number of links, labels and hrefs
Bar, hover pillar, text and divider colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Replace the text logo with an image or SVG
needsCodeEdit.where: The logoLabel anchor at the start of the inner flex div

needsCodeEdit.change: Change nav height or content width
needsCodeEdit.where: h-[60px] and w-[1100px] classes on the nav and inner div
fontFamily in the nav style object

fixed: Uses the DM Mono font family name but does not load it, the host page must provide it or it falls back to monospace
Hover wave offsets for the next two neighbors are hardcoded
Hover wave effect is desktop only, mobile uses the tap dropdown
